title: Prerrogativas parlamentarias y el Defensor del Pueblo
goal: Conocer la inviolabilidad e inmunidad de los parlamentarios, el Tribunal de Cuentas y la figura del Defensor del Pueblo.

items: Identify the 'Defensor del Pueblo' (Ombudsman) as the High Commissioner of the Cortes Generales who defends Title I rights (Article 54).
Identify the 'Tribunal de Cuentas' as the supreme auditing body of the State's public accounts (Article 136).
Explain parliamentary inviolability and immunity under Article 71.
Use 'encargado de + infinitivo' and 'designado por' to describe institutional mandates.
I can identify the 'Defensor del Pueblo' (Ombudsman) as the High Commissioner of the Cortes Generales who defends Title I rights (Article 54).
I can identify the 'Tribunal de Cuentas' as the supreme auditing body of the State's public accounts (Article 136).
I can explain parliamentary inviolability and immunity under Article 71.
I can use 'encargado de + infinitivo' and 'designado por' to describe institutional mandates.
